name: assess_batch_search
description: Find the target or select one visually grounded contextual clue from a camera sweep.

result.description: found means the requested target is definitively visible; candidate means one specific but not yet definitive piece of evidence is visible; not_found means neither the target nor useful evidence is visible.

candidate_type.description: For candidate only: visual means an object closely matches the target but is not confirmed. context means specific target-linked evidence or a recognized related place is visible within the current 85-degree view. speculative means only a generic possibility. Use null for found and not_found.

candidate_image.description: For found, the image containing the target. For candidate, the image containing the contextual clue. Use none for not_found.

target_position.description: For found only, a normalized point touching the target in candidate_image, using exactly x and y. x and y must be normalized between 0 and 1. (0,0) means top left corner, (1.0,1.0) means bottom right. Use null for candidate and not_found.

contextual_clue.description: For candidate only, a concise description of the visible clue, where it is, and why moving toward it may reveal the target. Use null for found and not_found.

name: assess_frame_search
description: Find the target or identify one useful contextual clue in a single camera frame.

result.description: found means the requested target is definitively visible; candidate means one specific but not yet definitive piece of evidence is visible; not_found means neither exists.

candidate_type.description: For candidate only: visual means an object closely matches the target but is not confirmed. context means specific target-linked evidence or a recognized related place is visible within the current 85-degree view. speculative means only a generic possibility. Use null for found and not_found.

target_position.description: For found only, a normalized point touching the target, using exactly x and y. x and y must be normalized between 0 and 1. (0,0) means top left corner, (1.0,1.0) means bottom right. Use null otherwise.

contextual_clue.description: For candidate only, concisely describe the visible evidence, its direction, and the target-specific reason for its category. Use null otherwise.

name: select_navigation_pose
description: Choose exactly one safe listed pose and final heading for this one-shot navigation call, or return blocked when no listed pose satisfies the mode contract.

decision.description: move selects the one permitted waypoint; blocked means no listed pose can satisfy the current mode. There is no later reassessment or correction.

pose_id.description: Exact candidate ID for move. Use only an ID listed for the current snapshot. Use null for blocked.

heading.description: Final centered-camera direction in the robot-upright map: forward is map up, left/right match the image, and backward is map down. Required for move and null for blocked.

reasoning.description: Briefly explain why the selected pose directly satisfies the current one-shot mode, or why every listed pose is blocked.
